Computer_terminal, please run the cleaning step:

```python
# filename: clean_and_prepare.py
import pandas as pd
import tabula

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/67e8878b-5cef-4375-804e-e6291fdbe78a.pdf"
tables = tabula.read_pdf(pdf_path, pages='all', multiple_tables=True)
df = pd.concat(tables, ignore_index=True)

section_types = {"Hotels", "Motels", "Villas", "Guesthouses", "Inns", "Resorts", "Cottages", "B&Bs"}

df['Type'] = None
current = None
for i, val in enumerate(df['Name'].astype(str)):
    name = val.strip()
    if name in section_types:
        current = name
        df.at[i, 'Type'] = None
    else:
        df.at[i, 'Type'] = current

clean = df[(df['Type'].notna()) & (df['Rating (out of 5)'].notna())].copy()
final_df = clean[['Name', 'Type', 'Rating (out of 5)']]
print(final_df.head(12))
print("\nType counts:\n", final_df['Type'].value_counts())
```
